name: Vornix E-E-A-T Enhancer
author: Vornix development team

sections.description:
The Vornix E-E-A-T Enhancer is a powerful tool designed to help content creators and website owners improve their content quality based on Google’s E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness) guidelines. This plugin provides a comprehensive analysis of your posts and pages, offering actionable insights and a clear overall score.

🌟 For a comprehensive guide, advanced strategies, and a detailed explanation of how to maximize your results with this plugin, please read the Full E-E-A-T Enhancer Guide on the Vornix Blog.

Key Features:
* Comprehensive E-E-A-T Analysis: Analyze your content against a set of key criteria, including author bios, title length, word count, external links, and more.
* Actionable Recommendations: Get practical recommendations to improve your content, with direct links to the relevant edit pages.
* Intuitive Admin Panel: Easily run analyses from a dedicated admin page.
* Gutenberg Editor Integration: Get instant E-E-A-T scores and recommendations directly inside the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) as you write.
* Detailed Reports: View and export detailed reports of your content analysis results, helping you track your progress over time.
* Lightweight and Efficient: Designed to be fast and not impact your site’s performance.

Help your content stand out and build trust with your audience and search engines.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vornix-eeat-enhancer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “E-E-A-T Enhancer” menu in your WordPress dashboard to start analyzing your content.
sections.faq:
What is the main benefit of this plugin?

The Vornix E-E-A-T Enhancer helps you align your content with Google’s quality guidelines, improving your SEO and user trust.

Is this plugin heavy on server resources?

No, it is designed to be lightweight and efficient, running analyses only when you request them from the admin panel or inside the editor.

Where can I find detailed tutorials for this plugin?

You can find full documentation and SEO tips in our official Vornix E-E-A-T guide.
sections.changelog:
0.1.7

  • Added compatibility support for WordPress 6.9.4.
  • Minor documentation updates and link enhancements for SEO.

0.1.6

Updated version with critical fixes and code standardization.
* Resolved class not found and TypeError issues.
* Standardized class naming with VXE_ prefix across the plugin.
* Optimized plugin boot process and service loading.
* Addressed Plugin Check warnings for database queries and escaping.

0.1.5

Initial development release.
Features: E-E-A-T analysis, reports, settings, and Gutenberg integration.
Initial set of rules: Author Bio, Title Length, Outbound Links, Word Count, Updated Recently, Has About Page, and HTTPS.
